title: Moss Calls for Nell
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, ow, oi, ear added, 47-sound stage.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee sitting together at the edge of a round garden pool.
Moss the hedgehog digging in the soil near a big oak tree a little way from the pool.
Moss the hedgehog looking up from his digging to find the spot beside him empty.
Moss the hedgehog standing up tall by the oak tree, calling out.
Moss the hedgehog glancing between the pool and the oak tree, checking both.
Moss the hedgehog digging again but pausing to call out every so often.
Moss the hedgehog with his head tilted, listening to a faint buzzing hum coming from the pool.
Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee sitting back together happily at the edge of the pool.
